tracks.caption: aggressive phonk, memphis rap, distorted 808 cowbell, dark, fast, male rap vocals, gym hype, cold CLI energy, heavy distortion, relentless hi-hats
tracks.lyrics:
[verse]
npm install commander, now I run the throne
lib/command.js so massive it's a zone of its own
spawning child processes, forwarding signals raw
examples/pizza ordering CLI, that's the law
suggestSimilar.js whisperin' "did you mean --first?"
command.option-misuse.test.js for the ones who hurt

[chorus]
npm install commander
npm install commander
one file rules the parser
npm install commander

[verse]
incrementing inspector ports in the dead of night
preAction, postAction, hooks wired up tight
examples/deploy — no deploy, just the vibe
passThroughOptions rolling through, unbothered, alive

[bridge]
three TODOs in the git hook, each one more vague
"replace with appropriate checks" — three times, that's the plague
nobody edits that file, it sits in the dark
npm run test-all, still hitting the mark

[chorus]
npm install commander
npm install commander
one file rules the parser
npm install commander

[outro]
Vue CLI bowed down, Create React App too
28k stars and the cowbell never stops — skrrt skrrt skrrt through
